events.description: A new approval request is pending.

events.name: feed.updated

events.description: The owner's feedback was recorded (explicit, or implicit where it happened: a draft edited before sending, an undo, an edited or denied approval, a dismissal, a redo).

events.description: A goal was created, confirmed, changed or archived.

events.description: Coarse and debounced: something behind growth.summary changed (a lesson, a metric, a milestone). Clients re-read it when the Growth view is open.
events.name: growth.updated

events.description: An idea was proposed, accepted, edited, dismissed or expired.
events.name: idea.updated

events.name: lesson.changed

events.description: Record meeting started or ended (stopped, silence, the conference app quit), or the ended recording's notes finished or failed (mail and meeting workflows §4.6).
events.name: meetings.recording.updated

events.description: A person, organisation, project or place changed in the memory graph.

events.description: A workspace file was created, changed or deleted (by a tool, the API, a job, or outside Psyche).

events.description: An open loop was created, confirmed, completed, snoozed or dismissed.

events.description: The graph suggests a merge or a project for the owner to confirm.

events.description: A node connected, disconnected or changed capabilities.

events.description: IDENTITY.md changed: clients refresh the header; maybe regenerate the avatar.

events.description: The agent asked the user structured questions (ask_user); no timeout.

events.name: run.updated

events.description: Settings changed (including appearance), so every paired client re-themes.

events.description: Skills changed: a reload, an install or removal, or a skill whose files no longer match its approved hash.

events.name: skills.draft.updated

events.name: skills.updated

events.description: A turn ended: the thread's context usage and limits (the context meter).

events.name: tool_call.updated

events.name: vault.unlocked

events.description: Gateway → desktop pane RPC for view.* (only the desktop shell acts on it).

methods.description: Approves or denies with the single-use answer token delivered to this surface; deviceOnly and requiresAuthentication kinds are enforced by the Gateway. Not idempotency-keyed: the token is single-use.

methods.name: approvals.get

methods.description: Lists approval requests (default: pending), newest first.
methods.name: approvals.list

methods.description: Creates a canvas artifact at version 1 (doc, code, table or image). Side-effecting: a retried key returns the same artifact.
methods.name: artifacts.create

methods.description: Returns one artifact's metadata (content through `artifacts.read`).
methods.name: artifacts.get

methods.description: Lists canvas artifacts, most recently updated first, optionally for one thread.
methods.name: artifacts.list

methods.description: Returns an artifact's content at a version, or a window of its lines.
methods.name: artifacts.read

methods.name: artifacts.update

methods.description: The desktop reports pane visibility and owner input (pause-when-unwatched).

methods.description: Re-verifies the hash chain and anchors; reports the first broken entry.

methods.description: Creates an automation (enabled by default). Side-effecting.

methods.name: backup.delete

methods.name: backup.list

methods.description: Adds or removes sender / group ids on one of a channel's allowlists. Side-effecting.

methods.description: Removes a channel transport secret (the Gateway-owned vault item channels.secrets.set stored; #511) and returns which secrets are still set. The channel cannot connect until it is set again. invalid_params for a name the type does not use. Audited. Side-effecting.
methods.name: channels.secrets.clear

methods.description: Stores a channel transport secret (Slack bot/app token, Discord bot token, SMS auth token) as a Gateway-owned vault item for that channel type and account, replacing an earlier one, and returns which secrets are now set. Agents can never fill it. invalid_params for a name the type does not use, unavailable when the vault cannot be opened. Side-effecting; its params are never logged.

methods.name: chat.followUp

Side-effecting: requires idempotencyKey.

methods.description: First run without a terminal: grants operator.admin to the calling device when the Gateway has no operator.admin device at all, in one transaction, and audits it as device.bootstrap_admin. Only the desktop shell's own connection may call it (loopback, no Origin, deviceFamily desktop, the per-launch handshake secret); forbidden otherwise, conflict once any admin exists. Side-effecting.

methods.description: Denies a pending pairing request.
methods.name: devices.deny

methods.name: devices.list

methods.description: Lists the registered helper presence keys (Touch ID approvals, issue #253): device id and key id only.
methods.name: devices.presenceKey.list

Replaces an earlier key; revoked with the device. methods.name: devices.presenceKey.register

methods.description: Removes a helper's registered presence key. Side-effecting.
methods.name: devices.presenceKey.remove

methods.description: Revokes a device's token and node authority permanently and closes its connections.

methods.description: Desktop only: inserts dictated text into the focused element (AX, else CGEvent typing); refuses secure fields and Psyche's windows; the text never reaches the agent. Side-effecting: a duplicate would type the text twice.

methods.description: Feedback events newest first (kept 180 days).
methods.name: feedback.list
